text:
leo_cs: Quick intake from Hearthline Retail (acct HL) — they want a multilingual product-title classifier (EN/ES/FR) + embeddings. Pilot target in 4 weeks. Key asks: synchronous scoring API, per-item latency goal p50 < 40ms, p99 < 120ms (avg title ~ 30 tokens). They also want 1536-dim embeddings for similarity + CDN caching.

pi_customer: hi team, correct. We'll supply ~10k titles total (mix of en/es/fr), some noisy labels to start. Can you confirm storage & masking rules? We cannot share raw customer emails or order numbers.

nora_privacy: understood. We need confirmation of automated redaction + hash-only retention for emails/order ids. No unredacted logs, test harness must run local redaction checks. DPA required before any persistent data used.

leo_cs: noted. CS: pilot -> hosted API first; if latency or throughput tight, they'll consider Dedicated (estimate initial qps 800, peak 2k). Renewal upside if pilot shows >10% reduction in false positives for search filters.

tanya_solutions: @pi_customer thanks. Can you drop a sample CSV (100 rows per lang) and a few edge-case titles (brand+emoji, multi-lingual punctuation)? We'll need 5k labeled titles per language for eval, plus 1k adversarial negatives. ETA for labels?

pi_customer: uploading seed samples via presigned S3 tonight; full labels will follow in 2 weeks (partner labeling). We can provide golden examples for critical SKUs now.

sam_sre: latency note: synchronous p99=120ms for single-item scoring is doable on hosted if we use a distilled 3B scoring model (int8/q4_x) and enable request-level batching on the client. For embeddings, async batch jobs or streaming cache are recommended. If peak qps >1500 hosted may need Dedicated pool.

leo_cs: risk note: if we miss latency and privacy controls, HL is unlikely to commit to Dedicated capacity at renewal. Mark as high-priority.

tanya_solutions: Eval plan: offline metrics NDCG@5, Recall@1/3, label F1; per-lang slices + brand-level fairness checks. Acceptance criteria: NDCG uplift >= 0.06 and per-lang F1 >= 0.88.

pi_customer: those thresholds sound fair. Any constraints on SKU tokens? We will mask SKUs with pattern SK_[0-9]{6} and provide a mapping file (hashed).

nora_privacy: send the SKU mapping hashed with customer-side salt. We'll validate no reversible mapping stored. Also require log-redact config.

sam_sre: perf command we'll run in staging for scoring model:
```
./bench_score --model ./models/3b-distilled-q4x --batch 16 --seq 32 --warmup 500 --measure p50,p95,p99
```

sam_sre: if that passes, staging run with real seed data and cache warmup.

tanya_solutions: action items:
1) seed sample + mapping from customer (100 rows/lang + hashed mapping) 1_pi_customer (ETA 24h)
2) offline eval harness (5k/lang when available) 1_tanya_solutions (ETA 5 days)
3) perf microbenchmarks on 3B distilled q4x (sam_sre) (ETA 3 days)
4) privacy checklist + DPA draft (nora_privacy) (ETA 4 days)
5) schedule kickoff + demo (leo_cs) 1 propose Thu 9am PT

pi_customer: seed upload started: hl_titles_seed_v1.csv (300KB) via presigned S3. I'll flag when full labels are ready. Thu 9am PT works.

leo_cs: tagging account team for visibility :eyes: please update tracker.

deploy-bot: Upload received: hl_titles_seed_v1.csv (312KB) 1753456796

pi_customer: small follow-up 1 our search infra returns ~12 candidates, they prefer we do client-side top-10 prefiltering before calling the scoring API to reduce model calls. Any guidance?

sam_sre: yes recommend client prefilter to 10 + compact scoring model. Also consider prefix KV caching for repeated product titles.

tanya_solutions: noted. We'll include client-side prefilter guidance in the enablement doc.

leo_cs: all right, we'll reconvene after perf + offline eval. Flag blockers here. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

pi_customer: thanks team :rocket:
